scope: five worlds, topology A, target vector (0,1,1,0,0), three binary unit-cost cues, at most two acquisitions, prior (1/3,1/6,1/6,1/6,1/6)
channel: independent epsilon=1/10 errors mixed with fully shared epsilon=1/10 errors with common-mode weight rho in [0,1]
identifiability_boundary: single-cue marginals do not identify rho; same-encounter joint errors do within the mixture if true cue values and perceived reports are known; three-cue law is otherwise unconstrained
independent_certificate: all 385 and 208 affine candidate policy lines dominated at exact segment endpoints with Fraction arithmetic, plus 101-point comparison against production optimizer
claim_ceiling: finite model and prospective paired-calibration design, not a pollinator fitness measurement or general sensory-noise theorem
